task.title: Decide consultation/source-ingest/search service disposition for single-VM baseline
task.summary_zh: 釐清 consultation、source-ingest、search 在 single-VM baseline 的處置：要納入 root compose 成為 deployable service，或明確標成 code exists, deployable service deferred，並回寫 SVC-SURFACES / SVC-COMPOSE 的依賴。
acceptance: consultation source-ingest and search implementation state is checked against code and compose
each service is classified as included in single-VM baseline or deployable service deferred
SVC-SURFACES and SVC-COMPOSE dependencies are updated to reflect the disposition
task.next: Owner finalized approved service disposition after verifying compose excludes consultation/source-ingestion/search, focused tests pass, and Claude review is recorded.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：consultation 已具備 FastAPI/Dockerfile，但 BFF 目前以 ConsultationStore 本地 data-dir 介面消費，故 deployable service activation 確實 deferred；source_ingestion 與 search 為 library-level、無 HTTP entrypoint/Dockerfile/health/compose 條目，deployable service 亦 deferred。SVC-SURFACES 與 SVC-COMPOSE 的 depends_on 與 acceptance criteria 已正確繼承 disposition 邊界。

後續追蹤：SVC-SURFACES 在 PANTHEON_BFF_ALLOW_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK=false 路徑必須維持 degraded/unavailable 或 fenced test-only seed；SVC-COMPOSE default profile 不得加入這三個 service，需引用 gap record；任何 source_ingestion/search 服務化 follow-up 需先定義 HTTP/job-trigger contract、Dockerfile、health、port、storage/env 與 smoke 才可納入 compose；consultation 服務化任務需額外決定 BFF 介接邊界（HTTP client 優先；顯式 shared-store 須個別 review）。

handoffs.message: Disposition ready for review. Recorded in starter-draft and phase2-phase6 gap inventory: consultation has FastAPI/Dockerfile code but deployable service activation is deferred because root compose does not run it and BFF is not yet a network client; source_ingestion and search remain library-level with no HTTP entrypoint/Dockerfile/health/compose contract, so deployable services are deferred. SVC-SURFACES inherits a negative boundary: do not add hidden normal-path dependencies on consultation/source-ingestion/search; expose degraded/unavailable or fenced test-only seed paths until explicit service wrappers exist. SVC-COMPOSE should leave all three out of the default profile and cite the gap record. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/source_ingestion/tests services/search/tests (13 passed); python3 services/consultation/run_smoke.py (2 passed); docker compose config --quiet (passed); git diff --check on edited docs (passed).
Review approved and returned to the owner for finalization
